title: 3.6 Graphical Representation of Motion
description: Graphical Representation of Motion concepts and applications. Hard level, 20 questions.

questions.question: An s-t graph is a straight line from (0 s, 0 m) to (4 s, 20 m), then horizontal to 8 s. What is the velocity in the first 4 s?
An s-t graph is straight from (0 s, 0 m) to (4 s, 20 m), then horizontal to 8 s. What is the object doing from 4 s to 8 s?
A v-t graph rises linearly from 0 to 12 m/s in 3 s, then stays at 12 m/s to 7 s. What is acceleration in the first 3 s?
A v-t graph rises linearly from 0 to 12 m/s in 3 s, then stays at 12 m/s to 7 s. What distance is covered from 3 s to 7 s?
An s-t graph has slope 3 m/s from 0 to 4 s and slope -2 m/s from 4 to 6 s. Taking +x as positive, what is displacement over 6 s?
An s-t graph has slope 3 m/s from 0 to 4 s and slope -2 m/s from 4 to 6 s. What total distance is covered?
A v-t graph is horizontal at 20 m/s from 0 to 5 s and at 10 m/s from 5 to 8 s. What is total distance?
A v-t graph is horizontal at 20 m/s from 0 to 5 s. What is the acceleration during that interval?
A car s-t graph is a straight line with slope -4 m/s along x. What is its speed?
An s-t graph shows 2 m at 0 s, 14 m at 2 s, and 14 m at 5 s. What is average velocity over 0 to 5 s?
An s-t graph shows 2 m at 0 s, 14 m at 2 s, and 14 m at 5 s. What distance is covered?
A v-t graph rises from 0 m/s to 10 m/s in 5 s, then stays there for 5 s. What is the average acceleration over the first 5 s?
A v-t graph is horizontal at 15 m/s. What is the area under the graph between 2 s and 6 s?
An s-t graph has slope 5 m/s for 0 to 2 s and slope 2 m/s for 2 to 6 s. Starting at 0 m, what is the position at 6 s?
An s-t graph has slope 5 m/s for 0 to 2 s and slope 2 m/s for 2 to 6 s. What is the average velocity over 0 to 6 s?
A v-t line slopes downward from 16 m/s at 0 s to 4 m/s at 4 s. What is the acceleration?
On a v-t graph, velocity is 5 m/s from 0 to 4 s. What distance is covered?
An s-t line goes from (0 s, 20 m) to (5 s, 5 m) along x. Taking +x as positive, what is the velocity?
A speed-time graph is horizontal at 60 km/h for 0.5 h. What distance is covered?
A speedometer reads 72 km/h while the v-t graph is horizontal. What is the acceleration?
